claim: The workaround is to switch the mender worktree back to `agentweave/mender` only when the tree is clean and the mend commit is already merged into master, verified by `git log master..mend/<task-id>` being empty.

citations.quote:
`git -C .agentweave/worktrees/mender switch agentweave/mender` when the tree is clean and the mend
commit is already merged into master (check with `git log master..mend/<task-id>`, which should
be empty).
